Invoice factoring

Turn outstanding invoices into working capital.

Keep your plans moving.

Finance selected outstanding invoices rather than committing every invoice. We focus on customer credit and the business model, including when your own credit score is lower. Submit your invoices for review. Approved invoices may be funded the same day or within 24 hours, subject to processing and agreed terms. There is no minimum invoice quota; our team can explain the requirements.

YOUR QUESTIONS, ANSWERED

Frequently asked questions

How does it work?

Upload your invoices for us to review and process. We'll send you the money on the same day.

Does my company qualify?

We don't see your company numbers, we see your clients' businesses and your business model to approve you. You can still get approved with a low credit score.

Do I have to sell all my invoices?

No. Just pick the ones you need.

How do I start?

Just click on the “Apply Now” button! Soon one of our team members will reach out. Or you can call us at El Paso (915) 219-7708 or Plano (214) 876 0504.

Eligibility, amounts, timing, rates, and conditions are subject to review and agreed terms. Request a written proposal from Blu.
